description: Technician Utilization opens with its Location filter set to All locations, so a user's first view mixes together every location they can reach. It is meant to open on the one location they are working in.
steps: Sign in as a user who can reach more than one location, and note the location beside your name at the top right — here it read Staging Heavy Duty - 9919, on an account that can also reach Staging Lethbridge - 4310.
In a browser with no saved settings for this report, open Reports, then Technician Utilization.
Read the Location filter at the right-hand end of the toolbar.
current:
The Location filter reads All locations. The page's first request carried no location at all and the second carried both.

The date range half of the same requirement is correct — it reads This Month and asks the server for 1 to 6 August 2026. Choosing a single location works and narrows the report correctly, so only the starting value is wrong.

For triage: the same starting behaviour on Inventory Value is SV-8931 and on Parts Velocity SV-8939. This ticket is Technician Utilization, which has its own requirement wording.
expected: On a first visit the Location filter is set to the user's currently active location — the one selected in the application's location switcher.
source: On the user's first visit (no saved settings — §3), the report defaults to the current calendar month (the date picker's "This Month" preset) and the user's currently active location.
On a first visit (no saved selection — §3), it defaults to the user's currently active location (the location currently selected in the application's global location switcher).
